title: ToT Mode
wikitext:
ToT mode is a bot game mode built in [[KTX]] by [[Slime]]. He created the game mode because he wanted a way to get back into shape when he started playing again in 2024. [[Hellfire]] was ToT's arch enemy so Slime decided to name the bots after old Hellfire players. Initially the game mode was supposed to be only an internal tool for ToT players, but [[Oddjob]] started marketing the mode to other players as well and it spread like wild fire. For another similar bot challenge, check [[Endif Bot Challenge]]. {{Tabs static |name1=Overview |link1=ToT_Mode |name2=E1M2 |link2=ToT_Mode_E1M2_Challenge |name3=DM4 |link3=ToT_Mode_DM4_Challenge |This=1 }} == How to play == ToT mode is enabled on a compatible server with these commands:
''botcmd enable''
''ffa''
''dmm4''
''/totmode''
''botcmd fill''
''ready'' It's worth noting that not every server has proper configuration files for the "official" ToT mode challenges. E.g. a fraglimit might be in place or level 10 bots could be added with ''botcmd fill'' instead of level 20 bots. Make sure the settings are fine before starting your grind.
